decision_recommendation.tier1: accept only with owner-controlled transactional authority, immutable canonical content, generation and dataset-revision history fencing, effect-bound boundary-single-winner recovery with restored-instance capability, same-path clone positive control, locked active surviving-authority binding, positive post-hardening claim-fetch-apply replay, consistent locked recovery-material fetch, and real-blackhole bounded recovery RPC
decision_recommendation.tier2: accept only under mediated shared history, explicit privileged automation boundary, genuine fresh-cluster reconstruction, total typed canonicalization, target-only signing authority and bounded dual-authority activation whose effective timeout path uses session retirement rather than synchronous remote cleanup

timeout cleanup is not bounded merely because response polling is bounded

max target ordinal is not completeness
